straddle.rule: Straddle is offered via a server-driven ask, not a client position rule. Server push NotifyAskingForStraddle (msg 4066: ActionId, Count, AmountToStraddle) -> OnAskingForStraddle shows StraddleDecideView for the user only if user isLive and balance>0; every live player with chips gets setStraddleTurn(true). Client has NO position check; UI text key MobileYouWillBeAbleToStraddle = 'You will be able to straddle at any position'.
straddle.evidence: OnAskingForStraddle.onDispatch; StraddleDecideView.init (pushstring 'MobileYouWillBeAbleToStraddle'); no position test in TableMenu3D.isStraddleButtonVisible
straddle.confidence: high for client; server who-is-eligible UNKNOWN

straddle.rule: Amount is server-computed (AmountToStraddle). Client sends Count=straddleAskCount (number of straddles so far) in DecideStraddleRequest (msg 3137); this is the doubling counter. Observed 4->8->16->32 is therefore server logic (2xBB then x2 each re-straddle); client does not compute it.
straddle.confidence: medium (doubling inferred from observation + Count field)

straddle.rule: Popup buttons: 'Straddle to $X' (MobileStraddleToOne) sends EStraddleDecideType.Yes; 'All-in to $Y' (MobileAllinToOne) sends AllIn; close sends No. All-in amount = user.balance + user.committedAmount; the Straddle-to button is visible only when AmountToStraddle < allInAmount (short stack sees only All-in).

Timer is server-driven: OnTimeBank with ETimeBankActionType.Straddle calls tableMediator.showStraddleTimer; StraddleDecideView hosts UserTimeBank/TimeBankChip/ExtraTimeBank widgets. Duration (~5s observed) is NOT in client code.
straddle.confidence: high that server-driven; value 5s UNKNOWN in static code

straddle.rule: Resolution: NotifyStraddleDecided (4067) with Type=No clears that player's straddle turn (and hides own UI); Yes/AllIn hides the UI and clears straddle turn for ALL players (one decision closes the ask round; likely next ask follows with higher Count). AllIn marks player.straddleAllIn.

Straddle is posted as a blind before cards, in the Blinds list: BlindType Straddle (or MandatoryStraddle) in NotifyTableBlindsPosted -> counted as live bet (committedAmount += BlindAmount; Dead/Ante go to pot instead). playInfo.lastStraddlePlayer set; straddleAllIn=true if balance==0 after post; seat shows balloon (showStraddleBalloon amount) = yellow 'Straddle to $X' sign.

Straddler acts last preflop / action order: NOT determined client-side (server sends AskAction). Only client use of lastStraddlePlayer is betting-shortcut selection in OnAskAction (no straddle player + PreFlop + not button-blind game).
straddle.confidence: UNKNOWN for order; observation in clone should rely on live capture

straddle.rule: Max number of straddles: not in client. Only evidence is the ask counter (Count) and all-in short circuit (isAllPlayersAllInStraddle when every playing player is all-in straddled). UNKNOWN cap.

Bottom-left 'Straddle' toggle = persistent auto-straddle preference, NOT a prompt trigger. StraddleCommand sets userPlayer.isOnStraddle, shows/hides the 'Straddle' badge on the seat, and sends setAutoActionFlags(EAutoActionFlag.PostStraddle(8192), on). Hotkey HotKey.STRADDLE sends SEND_STRADDLE(!isOnStraddle). Button visible only if isUserPlaying && tableInfo.straddle>0 && dealtPlayerCount>2; disabled in bomb-pot hands. Auto-cleared (STRADDLE false) when dealtPlayerCount<=2 (heads-up). When sitting back in, SitInCommand sends PostStraddle instead of PostBlinds if isOnStraddle.

Table-level enabling: TableInfo.straddle (from stake.Straddle) must be >0 for the toggle; stake also carries CanMandatoryStraddle (isCanMandatoryStraddle) and mandatoryStraddle amount (table name 'sb/bb/straddle'). Mandatory straddle is a separate table type (EBlindType.MandatoryStraddle).

sitout.rule: Sit-out countdown is server-provided: KickOutTime in NotifyTableSitOut (msg 4009) -> TablePlayer.kickOutEndTime; remaining = endTime - now (SitOutView shows mm:ss, 'Deal Me In' button has progress ring). Duration comes from timeBankInfo.sitoutTimeBank (TableInfo.sitOutTime; -1 = unlimited; rush/VIP HU/tourney/spin treated unlimited). Observed 02:00 = server value; not hard-coded in client.
sitout.confidence: high mechanism; 120s default is UNKNOWN statically (observed only)

sitout.rule: Timer speed-up: sitOutTimeSpeed=2 (hurry) when playInfo.waitingPlayersCount>0, else 1; remaining time shrinks by elapsed since hurryTimeStart (counts down at 2x while someone waits for a seat). Sit-out state emoticons (Smoking/Toilet/Drink/Charge) add time (sitOutAddedDuration).
At 0: server removes the player from the seat with ELeaveSeatReason.SitOutTimeExpired; desktop client shows alert 'YouHaveBeenRemovedYourSeat' (seat vacated, chips cashed to balance by server).
sitout.confidence: high for stand-up; chip handling server-side UNKNOWN

sitout.rule: Deal Me In (red button) -> GlobalSitInData{isAll,isFromDealMeIn} -> SitInCommand -> SitIn request (msg 3108) with AutoActionFlags = PostBlinds(1) [or PostStraddle(8192) if isOnStraddle] | timebank option | autoRemoveChip | autoRebuy. Client first clears sitOutReserved and the SitOutNextHand reservation. Requires balance >= TableInfo.dealMeInMin else OPEN_GET_CHIPS (ErrorNotEnoughBalance also opens Get Chips). dealMeInMin = stake.DealMin if >0, else 4xbuttonBlind if button-blind game, else 2xthirdBlind, else 2xBB.

Wait for Blinds checkbox = EAutoActionFlag.WaitForBlinds(256) toggled through AUTO_ACTION (NewWaitForButton; same flag whether waiting for big blind or straddle). It is the default on take-seat (CheckTakeSeatCommand passes WaitForBlinds). Semantics: player is dealt in only when the BB reaches them (no immediate post); PostBlinds (Deal Me In) instead posts now. Server enforcement UNKNOWN.
sitout.confidence: high on flag wiring; wait-for-BB semantics medium (name-based)

sitout.rule: 'Post Blind(s)' seat label: PlayerCell3D.setLabelBlind shows it for blind types Big, Small, Third or Dead posted by that seat (TableMediator.postBlinds -> setBlindType). Amount/dead-vs-live is server-supplied per blind in NotifyTableBlindsPosted; Dead blinds go to the pot not the bet (not live). Missed-blind accrual (debt) is server-side; client only tracks ActionHistoryInfo._hasMissedBlind/missedBlindAction for history.
sitout.confidence: high for display; BB-only vs BB+dead SB amount UNKNOWN

sitout.rule: After manual sit-out on a normal Hold'em/Omaha cash table, if balance < 4xbuttonBlind (button-blind) or < 2xBB the client opens Get Chips.
